scope: Minimal 013-to-integrated-v4 corpus adoption: exact remote corpus and plugin mirror, 80 published plus 2 excluded candidates, four reserved holdout metadata records preserved, ten targeted index tests, and twelve frozen AIK development cases on two backends in default/domain modes. Upstream new-card scientific results are provenance only; raw legacy retrieval scope is eight cases per backend, not 21. No new proofs, research, full catalog, model, production or performance claim.

implementation.procedure: Inspect actual evaluator, knowledge/index and all imported guard/ingestion/result modules; compare with accepted v3 source.
implementation.acceptance: Bound implementation is byte-exact v3; exact published SQLite IDs and candidate exclusion hold.

reference_boundary.procedure: Compare current 48 AIK rows with v3 frozen rows; inspect two holdout registries before card bodies; preserve new-card source results without rederivation.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Fixed cases/targets/budget, all changed ranks and failures explicit; no new scientific applicability claim.

data_integrity.procedure: Check full corpus/mirror equality with 013, prior entries/evidence immutability and before/after dependency hashes. Recompute actual upstream retrieval denominators.
data_integrity.acceptance: 80 published plus 2 candidates; four reserved records unchanged; eight legacy rows/backend despite 21-case prose; no lost old files.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Recompute default/domain hit counts from unique backend/case rows and check fulltext and character budget.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Exactly 24 rows/mode and 12 cases/backend; booleans and counts agree; no nonfinite JSON metrics.

measurement_validity.procedure: Distinguish new bounded development retrieval/index tests from upstream scientific metadata and historical broad-suite results.
measurement_validity.acceptance: No current full-suite/catalog, unseen model, automatic recovery or performance claim; all failures retained.

reproducibility.procedure: Bind code, protocol, input corpus/cases, old row baselines, raw outputs, commands and environment; independent reviewer inspects and cross-checks.
reproducibility.acceptance: Dependencies stable throughout this round; native record remains pending until independent verification.
